objective: Balance visitor value, organic audience growth and sustainable commission funding. Use first-party aggregate behavior and partner-confirmed evidence; never let commercial value change Earth ranking, source truth or currentness.

signals.meaning: Visitors are moving from discovery into planning/commercial intent.
Visitors find source handoffs useful; supports overall discovery utility but is weaker commercial evidence.
Sustained destination search activity demonstrates intentional discovery rather than passive page views.
Repeated gaps reveal where content expansion may unlock future planning demand.
Repeated place exploration helps distinguish useful destination demand from homepage impressions.
A confirmed booking/sale/commission in a partner dashboard is the strongest evidence that ERN commercial traffic is working.

revisitLockedProgramsWhen: Travelpayouts changes the program state or exposes link generation
aggregate travel_option_opened activity becomes sustained across multiple destinations
ERN records its first partner-confirmed conversion/commission
organic visitor/search activity grows materially enough that a new stay/activity/transport program would solve a demonstrated gap
doNotUse: outbound clicks as proof of bookings
invented numeric thresholds not provided by Travelpayouts

currentOperatingEvidence.interpretation: ERN is demonstrating real discovery use, but audience scale and repeat usage are currently a larger constraint than affiliate-program count. Improve the discover → explore → plan path before broadening commercial density.
currentOperatingEvidence.caveat: This is a time-bounded aggregate operating snapshot, not a promise of current traffic, reach, conversion or revenue.

balanceRules: Visitor value comes first within each experience: show the truthful Earth window before planning actions.
Audience growth is a first-class operating goal: improve crawlable destination sharing, search discovery, useful return paths and organic distribution.
Funding is a first-class sustainability goal: expose only verified, contextually useful affiliate actions after destination interest is established.
Do not add commercial buttons merely to raise offer counts.
Commission rate, partner status or payout cannot affect Earth ranking, source health, currentness or editorial prominence.
Use travel_option_opened as planning-intent evidence only; never treat it as a booking or commission.
Use partner-dashboard evidence for conversions and commission.
Prefer converting existing active-program coverage over opening more programs until traffic and planning demand justify them.
nextOperatingPriorities: Increase qualified organic visitors from search, social sharing, AI search and useful deep destination links.
Make destination shares resolve to crawlable place pages with destination-specific social metadata.
Improve repeat utility through current-place discovery, saved/recent places and trustworthy source maintenance.
Surface existing verified activities, culture and transport options naturally after a place is viewed.
Measure planning clicks by destination and provider; focus future commercial work on demonstrated visitor intent.
Revisit traffic-gated stay, transport and activity programs only when real audience/planning evidence or partner invitations justify it.
